  /* Matrix 02 전용 모던 CSS 듀얼 차트 스타일 */
  .css-chart-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 2.5rem;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;

  }
  .css-chart-box {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    width: 100%;

  }
  .css-donut-ring {
    width: 210px;

    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

  .tax-donut-value { font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 800; color: #1d1d1f; font-family: monospace; }

  .tax-kpi-row {
